title: Foundation specification
description: A global specification shared by every component (color, typography, spacing, focus ring…). Technology-agnostic like a component spec, but with no anatomy, role or properties: it owns semantic tokens, states what they mean as rules, presents the tokens it is built from as specimens, carries its own accessibility contract, contrast requirements checked in every platform x mode, examples rendered with the components that follow it, a decision log and a changelog. Shared definitions come from component.schema.json.

id.description: Unique among foundations and components. Same id for the docs page (docs/foundations/<id>.md) and the site page.

tokens.description: Semantic token paths (or group.* patterns) this foundation owns. Each must match at least one semantic token. Components follow the foundation by aliasing them. Empty while the foundation has no semantic decision yet: it then only presents raw primitives in its specimens.

appliesTo.description: Components that must follow the foundation. focusable-components: every component whose role profile is focusable aliases every exact token path of `tokens` (validated). Omit when following it is a choice.

rules.description: What the foundation IS, one aspect per rule (shape, width, color, trigger…). Present tense, technology-agnostic. The values live in the tokens.

tokens.description: Token paths carrying this aspect; shown with their value in every mode.

specimens.description: How the site presents the tokens the foundation is built from, raw primitives included: one section per specimen, drawing every token its patterns match, so a new token appears with no site change. The display says how a value is drawn; scripts/lib/specimens.mjs lists the displays and the $types each one draws.

description.description: What the scale is for, in one or two sentences.

tokens.description: Raw or semantic token paths or group.* patterns, never component tokens.

tier.description: Keep only the tokens of this tier, when raw and semantic tokens share a group (space.* holds the raw scale and the semantic space.inset.*).

contrast.description: Contrast pairs, computed by pnpm validate from the resolved tokens in every platform x mode context. A pair under its minimum is an error, a warning while knownIssue tracks it; a pair without minimum is measured and shown only.

description.description: Where the pair occurs, and why its minimum applies or why it has none.

foreground.description: Color token drawn by the foundation.

backgrounds.description: Color tokens (or group.*) the foreground can sit on.

on.description: Surfaces (color tokens or group.*) a translucent background is composited over before measuring, one pair per surface. Opaque backgrounds ignore it. Without it, a translucent background is composited over white.

minimum.description: Required ratio: a pair under it fails pnpm validate. Omit it to measure a pair that has no requirement (an inactive component, a border that does not identify a component): computed and shown, never failing.

knownIssue.description: A short description of the known problem behind pairs under the minimum (what fails and why it is kept for now), tracked in the issue backlog: pnpm validate reports them as warnings instead of errors, and fails once every pair passes, so the marker is removed with the fix. Requires minimum.

accessibility.description: Same grammar as a component's guidelines and references (component.schema.json); no role, name or keyboard.

examples.description: What the foundation looks like in use, rendered on its page in every mode: components following it, rendered by their web template with these props (the sandbox `state` prop forces a state), or code samples highlighted with the system's syntax theme.

source.description: A code sample: a file next to the spec, in specs/foundations/<foundation id>/. Its extension names the language: css, diff, html, js (JavaScript), json, md (Markdown), sh (shell), yml (YAML), the grammars the docs site loads. Shiki's notation comments ([!code highlight], [!code ++], [!code --], [!code error], [!code warning]) mark lines.

decisions.description: Decision log, newest first, same rules as a component's.
